questions.question: Mina, now a national reference in orthodontics, is invited to an international congress. What message should she convey?
options: Orthodontics is a model of balance and harmony
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthodontics is a model of balance and harmony.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Sami must create a foundation to promote orthodontic health. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Promoting facial balance and function is essential for the future.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Mina must write a reference work on orthodontics. What is the central message?
options: Orthodontics is an art that combines diagnosis, planning, and technique
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthodontics is an art that combines diagnosis, planning, and technique.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should he leave?
options: Orthodontics is in full evolution, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Orthodontics is in full evolution, full of opportunities.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must create a mentoring program in orthodontics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental skills in orthodontics.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Sami must manage the succession of his expertise in orthodontics. What is the best strategy?
options: Progressively prepare the transmission of skills
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Progressive preparation for transmission is the key to a successful succession.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Mina must create a charter for orthodontics. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Personalized diagnosis and planning are the pillars of any orthodontic charter.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must train future mentors in orthodontics. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Mina must prepare a testimony on her journey in orthodontics. What is the most striking element?
options: The satisfaction of seeing transformed smiles
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The satisfaction of seeing transformed smiles is the most striking element.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an alumni association for orthodontics. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the bond and promote mutual aid
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mutual aid and the bond are the driving forces of an alumni association.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Mina must write an article on the future of orthodontics. Which trend should be emphasized?
options: The decrease in needs for orthodontics
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Digital innovation serving balance is a promising trend.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create a quality label for orthodontics. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Quality of diagnosis and planning are the fundamental criteria.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
options: The profession needs enthusiasts of balance
The profession is of no interest
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The profession needs enthusiasts of balance.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an award for young dentists in orthodontics. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Excellence in orthodontics is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Mina must write her memoirs. What common thread should be highlighted?
options: The passion for orthodontics and service to patients
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The passion for orthodontics is the common thread of a professional life.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create a training center in orthodontics. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Training must produce professionals of facial balance.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Orthodontic skills and an example to follow
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthodontic skills and an example to follow are the most beautiful legacy.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must write a letter to future dentists about orthodontics. What message should he convey?
options: Orthodontics is a fascinating and promising discipline
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Orthodontics is a fascinating and promising discipline.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Mina must create a scholarship for students in orthodontics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Supporting deserving students is an investment for the future.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Sami must give a closing speech. What note should he leave?
options: Orthodontics continues to evolve with those who carry it
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Orthodontics continues to evolve thanks to those who carry it.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Mina must pass on her orthodontic knowledge. What is the priority?
options: Sell her knowledge at the highest price
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Transmitting the continuity of skills is the most beautiful achievement.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create a peer network for young dentists in orthodontics. What is the objective?
options: Promote mutual aid and experience sharing
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mutual aid and sharing are essential for young dentists.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Mina must write a conclusion to her work. What is the final sentence?
options: Orthodontics is a magnificent human adventure
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthodontics is a magnificent human adventure.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must leave a message for future generations. What is the message?
options: Orthodontics is a discipline worth experiencing
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Orthodontics is a discipline worth experiencing.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Mina, after a life dedicated to orthodontics, receives a national tribute. Sami is by her side. What is Mina's message to young dentists?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina concludes: 'Orthodontics needs passion and dedication to continue evolving.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'
